grammar.title: Modals of Deduction: must
grammar.rule:
📘 **Must для предположений**:

Мы используем **must**, когда мы УВЕРЕНЫ на 90-100%, что что-то правда.

📌 **Формула**:
✅ [subject] + **must** + [infinitive]

📌 **Примеры**:
✅ She **must** be a doctor. She works at a hospital.
✅ He **must** be tired. He works 12 hours a day.
✅ They **must** have a lot of money. They have a big house.

📌 **Внимание!**
❌ **mustn't** НЕ используется для предположений!
✅ Для отрицательных предположений используем **can't**.

📌 **Пример**:
✅ She **must** be happy. She's smiling.
❌ She **mustn't** be happy. (НЕПРАВИЛЬНО!)
✅ She **can't** be happy. She's crying. (ПРАВИЛЬНО!)

exercises.question: She's smiling. She ___ be happy. 😊
He works 12 hours a day. He ___ be tired. 😴
exercises.explanation: 12 hours a day = must be tired! 😴

exercises.question: She ___ have a good job. She drives a Porsche. 🚗 (must / can't)
exercises.explanation: Porsche = must have a good job! 🚗

exercises.question: He's yawning. He ___ be sleepy. 😴 (must / can't)
She mustn't be happy. She's crying.
exercises.correct: She can't be happy. She's crying.
accept: She can't be happy. She's crying
She can't be happy. She's crying.
exercises.explanation: For negative deductions, use can't, not mustn't! ❌

days.title: Day 4: Grammar — Modals of Deduction (might and can't)
days.description: Учим might для возможных и can't для невозможных предположений

grammar.title: Modals of Deduction: might and can't
grammar.rule:
📘 **Might для возможных предположений**:

Мы используем **might / may / could**, когда мы НЕ УВЕРЕНЫ (50-70%).

📌 **Формула**:
✅ [subject] + **might** + [infinitive]

📌 **Примеры**:
✅ She **might** be a doctor. I'm not sure.
✅ He **may** be at home. Let's call him.
✅ They **could** be on holiday. I don't know.

📘 **Can't для невозможных предположений**:

Мы используем **can't**, когда мы УВЕРЕНЫ, что что-то НЕПРАВДА.

📌 **Формула**:
✅ [subject] + **can't** + [infinitive]

📌 **Примеры**:
✅ He's only 15. He **can't** be a university student.
✅ She's laughing. She **can't** be sad.
✅ It's summer. It **can't** be snowing.

exercises.question: I'm not sure, but she ___ be a teacher. 👩‍🏫
He's only 10 years old. He ___ be a doctor. 🩺
exercises.explanation: 10 is too young! He can't be a doctor! 🩺

exercises.question: He ___ be American. He has a British accent. 🇬🇧 (can't / must)
She's looking at a map. She ___ be lost. 🗺️ (might / must)
exercises.explanation: Looking at a map = might be lost! 🗺️

exercises.question: He's wearing shorts in winter. He ___ be cold. ❄️ (can't / must)
exercises.explanation: Shorts in winter = can't be cold! ❄️

days.title: Day 5: Practice — Modals of Deduction + Body
days.description: Соединяем модальные глаголы и описание внешности

grammar.title: Modals of Deduction + Body — Practice
grammar.rule:
📘 **Соединяем всё вместе**:

📌 **must** — уверен:
✅ He must be a sportsperson. He has a strong body.
✅ She must be tired. She has bags under her eyes.

📌 **might** — возможно:
✅ He might be a model. He's tall and slim.
✅ She might have a beard. I can't see properly.

📌 **can't** — невозможно:
✅ He's bald. He can't have long hair.
✅ She's short. She can't be a basketball player.

📌 **Пример**:
He has a beard and glasses. He must be a professor.
She has blonde hair and blue eyes. She might be Swedish.
He's only 1.5 metres tall. He can't be a basketball player.

exercises.question: He has a beard and glasses. He ___ be a professor. 🧑‍🏫
exercises.explanation: Beard + glasses = must be a professor! 🧑‍🏫

exercises.question: She's only 1.5 metres tall. She ___ be a basketball player. 🏀
He has a strong body. He ___ be a sportsperson. 💪 (must / might)
exercises.explanation: Strong body = must be a sportsperson! 💪

exercises.question: She has blonde hair and blue eyes. She ___ be Swedish. 🇸🇪 (might / can't)
exercises.explanation: Blonde hair + blue eyes = might be Swedish! 🇸🇪

exercises.question: He mustn't be a student. He's 40 years old.
exercises.correct: He can't be a student. He's 40 years old.
accept: He can't be a student. He's 40 years old
He can't be a student. He's 40 years old.
exercises.explanation: Use can't, not mustn't, for negative deductions! ❌

days.title: Day 6: Writing — Describing a Person
days.description: Пишем описание человека, используя внешность и предположения

grammar.title: Повторение: body, appearance, modals of deduction
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What does the person look like? (Как выглядит человек?)
2️⃣ What are their features? (Какие у него/неё особенности?)
3️⃣ What do they wear? (Что они носят?)
4️⃣ What can you guess about them? (Что ты можешь предположить о них?)
5️⃣ Why do you think that? (Почему ты так думаешь?)

📌 **Пример**:
I see a woman. She is tall and slim with long blonde hair. She wears glasses and a smart dress. She must be a businesswoman because she looks confident. She might be in her 30s. She can't be a student because she's too old.

exercises.question: I see a ___ . (man / woman)
He/She is ___ and ___ . (напиши рост и телосложение)
He/She has ___ hair and ___ . (напиши цвет и ещё одну деталь)
He/She ___ be a ___ . (must / might / can't + профессия)
I think this because ___ . (напиши причину)
